title: Arakelov inequalities for fibered surfaces in positive characteristic
summary: Let $f:S\to C$ be a relatively minimal semistable fibration of genus $g\ge2$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$ with smooth and geometrically connected generic fiber. Let $Σ\subset C$ denote the set of points over which the fibers are singular, with $s=|Σ|$. If the total surface $S$ is Hodge Witt and $s\ge2$, we prove the classical Arakelov inequality $$ \text{deg}\, f_*ω_{S/C}\le \frac g2 \text{deg}\, Ω_C^1(\logΣ), $$ where $ω_{S/C}$ denotes the relative dualizing sheaf.
